scripts.db:generate: npx dotenv -e .env -- pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:deploy: npx dotenv -e .env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:status: npx dotenv -e .env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:generate:dev: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:deploy:dev: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status:dev: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- pnpm exec prisma migrate status
scripts.db:generate:prod: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:deploy:prod: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status:prod: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- pnpm exec prisma migrate status
